name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep your chest up and alternate legs as you walk forward.

name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet. Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Keep your back long and brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball near the floor.
Rotate to the other side. Each side counts as one rep.

name: Side Plank Single Leg Crunch
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm in a side plank, hips lifted.
Place your free hand behind your head.
Draw your top knee up toward your elbow while bringing the elbow down to meet it.
Extend back out under control. Finish all reps, then switch sides.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or lever across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Crunch Clap
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms stretched overhead.
Curl your shoulders and chest off the floor while swinging your arms forward.
Clap your hands in front of your knees at the top.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Sit Up & Overhead Throw
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up fast and throw the ball forward to a partner or a wall.
Catch the ball on the return and lower your back to the floor under control.
Reset the ball overhead and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a kettlebell by the handle in front of your thighs.
Pull the kettlebell up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height with elbows at or just below shoulder level.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall and sit your hips down between your knees.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the bars slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself fully under control until your arms are straight.
Log the assistance weight: less assistance means you are lifting more of your own bodyweight.
